title: Kinney Drugs pulls back AI phone assistant after hundreds of customer complaints
summary:
Kinney Drugs is scaling back its AI phone assistant, "Burt," after hundreds of customer complaints about incoherent calls, incorrect dosage information, and missed prescription notifications. The AI, named after the pharmacy chain's founder, was introduced in May to handle patient communication about prescriptions and refills.

Customers reported significant problems with the technology, prompting the company to revert to its traditional touch-tone phone system for incoming patient calls. Kinney Drugs President John Marraffa acknowledged the failure, stating that while privacy and security were handled correctly, the customer experience was not, and the company takes responsibility.

Privacy concerns were also raised, with customers worried that an AI platform could expose their personal health information. Marraffa reassured that Burt is fully HIPAA compliant, is not open-source, and does not generate or manipulate data. Despite the pullback, Kinney will continue using Burt for outbound communications, such as prescription refill texts, but patients must opt in to receive them.
chinese_title: Kinney Drugs因数百起客户投诉撤下AI电话助手
chinese_summary:
Kinney Drugs正在缩减其AI电话助手“Burt”的使用规模，此前有数百名客户投诉称该助手出现通话内容不连贯、剂量信息错误以及错过处方通知等问题。这款AI以该药店连锁创始人的名字命名，于今年5月上线，负责处理患者关于处方和续药的沟通。

客户反映该技术存在严重问题，促使公司恢复使用传统的按键式电话系统来接收患者来电。Kinney Drugs总裁John Marraffa承认了这一失败，他表示，虽然隐私和安全方面处理得当，但客户体验不佳，公司对此负有责任。

此外，隐私问题也引发担忧，客户担心AI平台可能泄露其个人健康信息。Marraffa安抚称，Burt完全符合HIPAA（健康保险携带和责任法案）合规要求，不是开源的，也不会生成或篡改数据。尽管有所收缩，Kinney仍将继续使用Burt进行外呼沟通，例如发送处方续药短信，但患者必须主动选择接收此类信息。

title: Learning more about Claude's mathematical capabilities
summary:
Anthropic researchers gave an unreleased research version of Claude the challenge of taking “a real stab” at the Riemann hypothesis. While it did not solve the famous problem, Claude unexpectedly improved a related result: it raised the proven lower bound for the proportion of zeros of the Riemann zeta function on the critical line from 41.6% to 67.2%.

The finding builds on prior work by Baluyot, Goldston, Suriajaya, and Turnage-Butterbaugh, combined with a 2000 paper by Bombieri. Claude used a space of functions with a quadratic form, treating positive- and negative-definite subspaces together, and derived an inequality using first- and second-moment information.

Methodologically, Claude worked in Claude Code with 60 subagents over two sessions, using 31 million output tokens. It ran thousands of numerical checks, downloaded 54 arXiv papers to rule out prior work, and independently re-proved its result. Two Anthropic mathematicians, Levent Alpöge and Ralph Furman, validated the proof, and external experts Brian Conrey and Dan Goldston examined it. Claude also produced a formally verifiable Lean proof.

Claude initially doubted its own result, but encouragement from handlers helped it continue. Anthropic notes this achievement does not likely lead to proving the Riemann hypothesis, but highlights the rapid progress of AI models in mathematics. The article links to Claude’s paper, formalization, informal note, explanation, and transcripts.
chinese_title: 深入了解Claude的数学能力
chinese_summary:
Anthropic研究员给Claude的一个未发布研究版本提出了挑战，要求它对黎曼猜想进行“真正的尝试”。虽然它没有解决这个著名问题，但Claude出人意料地改进了一个相关结果：它将黎曼ζ函数在临界线上的零点比例的下界从41.6%提高到了67.2%。

这一发现建立在Baluyot、Goldston、Suriajaya和Turnage-Butterbaugh先前工作的基础上，并结合了Bombieri在2000年发表的一篇论文。Claude使用了一个带有二次型的函数空间，将正定和负定子空间放在一起处理，并利用一阶和二阶矩信息推导出了一个不等式。

在方法论上，Claude在Claude Code中通过两次会话使用了60个子代理，消耗了3100万输出令牌。它运行了数千次数值检查，下载了54篇arXiv论文以排除已有工作，并独立地重新证明了自己的结果。两位Anthropic数学家Levent Alpöge和Ralph Furman验证了这一证明，外部专家Brian Conrey和Dan Goldston对其进行了审查。Claude还生成了一份可正式验证的Lean证明。

Claude最初对自己的结果持怀疑态度，但来自操作人员的鼓励帮助它继续了下去。Anthropic指出，这一成就不太可能带来黎曼猜想的证明，但它凸显了AI模型在数学领域的快速进步。文章附有Claude的论文、形式化证明、非正式笔记、解释和对话记录的相关链接。

title: There is no “done”: Reflections on a completed Appalachian Trail thru-hike (2022)
summary:
Emilee Hackney reflects on completing her 2022 Appalachian Trail thru-hike, five and a half months and 2,200 miles after starting in March. Waking up at home in Virginia, she still reacts instinctively to rainy forecasts, but realizes she no longer has to hike in it.

She explains that she stopped blogging around Tennessee because she was too physically and mentally exhausted to write. When people ask how the hike was, she struggles to sum it up: “Hard. Fun. Rewarding. Scary. Wild. Amazing.”

The deeper thread of the piece is grief. She hiked partly to process her father’s death, initially hoping to distract herself from it. The trail broke down her defenses, forcing her to feel everything: joy, fear, anger, and especially sorrow. She cried constantly, but it became healing. She learned that “the only way out is through,” both on the trail and in grief. One example is Mahoosuc Notch, a difficult boulder field she dreaded but had to cross.

She reflects on the impermanence of all things—even ancient mountains—and finds peace in accepting life’s cycles. By the end, she realizes grief is never “done”; it remains a connection to her father. Descending Katahdin after summiting, another hiker describes the feeling as “peaceful,” and she agrees. The article ends with a blessing: “I wish you all very happy trails.”
chinese_title: 没有真正的“完成”：2022年阿巴拉契亚小径全程徒步后的思考
chinese_summary:
艾米莉·哈克尼回顾了她完成2022年阿巴拉契亚小径全程徒步的经历——从三月开始，历时五个半月，行程2200英里。在弗吉尼亚州的家中醒来，她仍然会本能地对降雨预报作出反应，但意识到自己不再需要冒雨徒步了。

她解释说，大约在田纳西州时，她停止了写博客，因为身心俱疲，无法写作。当人们问起这次徒步怎么样时，她难以总结：“艰难、有趣、值得、可怕、狂野、奇妙。”

这篇文章更深层的脉络是悲伤。她徒步的部分原因是为了处理父亲的去世，最初希望能借此分散自己的注意力。小径打破了她的防备，迫使她感受一切：喜悦、恐惧、愤怒，尤其是悲伤。她不停地哭泣，但这变成了治愈。她学到了“唯一的出路是穿越它”，无论是在小径上还是在悲伤中。一个例子是马霍苏克隘口，一片她害怕但又必须穿越的艰难巨石地带。

她反思一切事物的无常——即使是古老的山脉——并在接受生命的循环中找到平静。到最后，她意识到悲伤永远不会“结束”；它仍然是与她父亲的一种联系。登顶后下撤卡塔丁山时，另一位徒步者形容那种感觉为“平静”，她表示同意。文章以祝福结尾：“祝你们大家都有非常愉快的旅途。”

title: Run Android ARM64 VR APKs on Apple Vision Pro
summary:
Klepton is a project that lets Android ARM64 VR apps—particularly Beat Saber—run on Apple Vision Pro and macOS without needing a JIT. It works by translating Android `.so` libraries into loadable macOS/visionOS dylibs/frameworks, then linking them into the Klepton runtime. Currently it supports Java-thin apps only; there is no ART or JVM.

Graphics translation is handled through ANGLE for GLES 3.2 converted to GLES 3.0 with a Metal backend, and Vulkan is translated via MoltenVK. The runtime includes several compatibility layers: `libklepton_bionic` maps Android libc/libm/libdl/pthread/log to Apple’s libSystem; `libklepton_ndk` implements Android NDK APIs like ALooper, ANativeWindow, ASensor, and AAsset; `libklepton_jni` provides synthetic JavaVM/JNIEnv; and `libklepton_ovrp` reimplements Oculus VR Platform functions. The frontend uses MoltenVK, ANGLE, Compositor Services, ARKit, GameController, and AVAudioEngine.

A key technical issue is that Android and macOS both reserve the x18 register, but macOS zeros it on context switches. Since many older Android apps use x18, Klepton patches all x18 usage to use per-library TLS slots instead.

The project can also load and patch `.so` files at runtime using `mmap`, but this is only useful on macOS because JIT is allowed there. Some apps may still require JIT if they rely on scripting runtimes such as LuaJIT or V8.

Build instructions are in BUILDING.md. Basic prerequisites include `brew install pkg-config sdl3 apktool`, extracting the APK with `apktool`, and running `make check`. Quick scripts like `build_run_viewer.sh`, `build_run_vpro.sh`, and `build_run_slink.sh` are provided for different targets.

Status: Beat Saber works on macOS and visionOS with minor graphical issues; Steam VR Link and broader generalizability/build tooling are still work in progress.

title: Claude moves bound of the Riemann Hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2%
summary: Claude was asked by Jarred Sumner to solve the Riemann Hypothesis. It did not fully solve the problem, but within 1.5 days it proved that at least 67% of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function lie on the critical line—a significant improvement over the previous known bound of 41.6%. The result reportedly excited analytic number theorists and highlights Claude's growing mathematical capabilities.
chinese_title: Claude将黎曼猜想的界从41.6%推进至67.2%

title: An Interesting Fourier Transform – 1/f Noise (2007)
summary:
The article discusses a notable property of power-law functions: their Fourier transforms are also power laws. Specifically, for a one-sided time-domain function u(t) t^α, the transform magnitude is proportional to ω^-(α+1), with an additional Gamma-function scaling factor Γ(α+1) and a phase term. Examples range from α = -2 to α = 2; α = 0 gives the unit step and the ideal integrator’s 1/ω response, while α = 1 corresponds to a cascade of two integrators (1/ω²).

A special case occurs at α = -1, where the Gamma function is undefined. More interesting is α = -0.5: both domains have the same power-law exponent, making u(t)t^-1/2 and its transform magnitude ω^-1/2 self-similar.

The author connects this to 1/f noise, a poorly understood noise found in electronics, traffic, music, DNA, and elsewhere. Its power spectrum is ~1/f, so its amplitude spectrum is ~1/f^1/2. Therefore, 1/f noise is, in a limited sense, its own Fourier transform: a pulse shaped as u(t)t^-1/2 produces a 1/f power spectrum, and passing white noise through a filter with that impulse response creates 1/f noise. However, a clear physical interpretation remains elusive. The phase of real 1/f noise is unknown, and the corresponding time-domain waveform may not simply be t^-1/2. The author suggests the fact that both Gaussian curves and power laws are self-Fourier may offer a clue, and invites research directions on this enduring mystery.
chinese_title: 一个有趣的傅里叶变换——1/f噪声（2007）
chinese_summary:
文章讨论了幂律函数的一个显著性质：它们的傅里叶变换也是幂律。具体而言，对于单边时域函数 u(t) t^α，其变换幅度正比于 ω^-(α+1)，并带有额外的伽马函数缩放因子 Γ(α+1) 和相位项。例子涵盖 α = -2 到 α = 2；α = 0 给出单位阶跃和理想积分器的 1/ω 响应，而 α = 1 对应于两个积分器的级联（1/ω²）。

特殊情况出现在 α = -1，此时伽马函数无定义。更有趣的是 α = -0.5：两个域具有相同的幂律指数，使得 u(t)t^-1/2 及其变换幅度 ω^-1/2 具有自相似性。

作者将此与1/f噪声联系起来，这是一种在电子、交通、音乐、DNA等中发现的尚未被充分理解的噪声。其功率谱约为1/f，因此其幅度谱约为1/f^1/2。因此，在有限意义上，1/f噪声是它自身的傅里叶变换：形状为 u(t)t^-1/2 的脉冲产生1/f功率谱，而将白噪声通过具有该冲激响应的滤波器则会生成1/f噪声。然而，清晰的物理解释仍然难以捉摸。真实1/f噪声的相位未知，相应的时域波形也可能并非简单的 t^-1/2。作者指出，高斯曲线和幂律都是自傅里叶的这一事实或许能提供线索，并邀请人们在这一长期谜团上探索研究方向。

title: What's the best programming language for coding agents?
summary:
The article critically examines claims that dynamically typed or highly concise languages are more token-efficient for LLM-based coding agents. It cites earlier evaluations suggesting languages like Clojure and J outperform static languages, but argues those results are unreliable because the tasks were trivial and the evals contained methodological flaws, including a symlink error that corrupted test scoring.

To test the claim, the author ran two larger, more realistic evals:

1. **Zstd decoder**: Agents implemented a decoder from the RFC without tests.
2. **Pandoc**: A modified TDD-style eval using ProgramBench materials and holdout tests.

The results showed that **no language type clearly dominates**. At medium effort, dynamic languages looked somewhat better, but at higher effort, static languages often matched or surpassed them. The extreme token efficiency advantages seen in trivial tasks disappeared on larger problems. Obscure or "weird" languages like J and Assembly performed poorly, while more popular languages showed a weak-to-moderate correlation with better and cheaper results.

The author’s pre-registered guesses were largely confirmed:
- The blanket claim that dynamic languages are more token-efficient for LLMs did **not** hold.
- The idea that J or other dense languages would be superior did **not** hold.
- Static languages being better at ultra effort was **not** clearly supported.

Common claims—that PHP’s bad code reputation harms performance, that powerful languages like Haskell are better, or that dynamic languages win on small tasks but static wins on large ones—were not supported by these evals. The article concludes that most broad claims about language suitability for LLMs are unreliable, and that such questions are only now becoming testable via LLM-based evaluation.
chinese_title: 对于编码代理来说，最好的编程语言是什么？
chinese_summary:
这篇文章批判性地考察了关于动态类型或高度简洁的语言对基于LLM的编程智能体更具令牌效率的说法。文章引用了早期评估，这些评估似乎表明Clojure和J等语言优于静态语言，但作者认为这些结果并不可靠，因为任务过于简单，且评估存在方法论缺陷，包括一个导致测试评分出错的符号链接错误。

为了验证这一说法，作者运行了两个更大、更贴近实际的评估：

1. **Zstd解码器**：智能体需在无测试的情况下，根据RFC实现解码器。
2. **Pandoc**：一个改写的TDD风格评估，使用ProgramBench材料及留出测试集。

结果显示，**没有任何语言类型明显占据主导地位**。在中等投入下，动态语言看起来稍好一些，但在更高投入下，静态语言往往能与之持平或超越。在琐碎任务中看到的极端令牌效率优势，在更大问题中消失了。J和汇编等冷门或“奇异”语言表现不佳，而更流行的语言则与更好、更便宜的结果呈现弱到中等程度的相关性。

作者预先注册的猜想大多得到证实：
- “动态语言对LLM更具令牌效率”的笼统说法**不成立**。
- “J或其他高密度语言会更优越”的想法**不成立**。
- “静态语言在超高投入下表现更好”并未得到明确支持。

title: Findphone: Locate a nearby Bluetooth device by signal strength
summary:
`findphone` is a command-line tool for macOS that locates a nearby Bluetooth device by signal strength. It is designed for situations where Find My is unavailable—for example, when an MDM profile disables it—but the device is still within Bluetooth range.

**Installation:** Download the universal binary from Releases, clear macOS quarantine with `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine findphone`, then run `./findphone --help`. Requires macOS 13 or later. Can also be built from source with Swift; no dependencies.

**Usage:** Running `findphone` surveys nearby Apple handhelds by signal. `findphone iphone` tracks one device by case-insensitive name. `findphone --list` shows paired devices and addresses. `--sound` adds parking-sensor-style clicks that speed up as you get closer, rising to a buzz around -50 dBm. `--redact` masks Bluetooth addresses and device names for screen recording, though hunt-mode target names and `--list` output remain visible.

Signal strength is shown in dBm; higher (less negative) values mean closer. Rough guides: -45 up is arm’s reach, -60 same table, -72 same room, -85 far or behind cover. Signal is a coarse proxy for distance; walls and metal affect it.

**How it works:** It combines three sources: connected GATT link `readRSSI()` (best), passively observed BLE advertisements, and classic link RSSI from `system_profiler`, which can serve cached values for 3–12 seconds, so only changed values are counted.

**Limitations:** Cannot make a device ring, cannot give direction, and only works within Bluetooth range (~10–20 m indoors) with Bluetooth powered on.

title: Show HN: A tiny LLM running at 21,000 tok/s on a $250 FPGA (Live Demo)
summary:
A developer squeezed a 3.16-million-parameter language model (INT4, ~1.5 MB) entirely into the on-chip SRAM of a $250 AMD KV260 FPGA, achieving 59,965 tokens/s across 16 parallel streams and ~21,300 tok/s for a faithful single-stream chat. The same model runs at 11 tok/s on the board's Arm cores and 719 tok/s on an RTX 3050 Ti.

The core insight: single-stream token generation is memory-bandwidth bound—every weight must be read per token. Since the board's DDR (~20 GB/s) is shared between CPU and fabric, a DDR-resident model buys nothing; keeping all weights in on-chip URAM/BRAM (~3 MB, hundreds of GB/s to TB/s) is the entire trick. The model uses TinyStories training data and a Kevin Malone-style lemmatization ("why use many word when few do trick") that compresses output by ~30%, yielding about 1.5x effective speedup.

The 100,000 tok/s goal was missed; the author proved a hard ceiling of 62k–78k tok/s because the chip lacks enough DSPs to pack a third MAC per DSP48E2. The 16-stream record is admittedly degenerate (attention window of one token, meaningless text); the deployed honest build runs one stream with full context and ~21,300 tok/s, stable from 1 to 2,000 concurrent connections.

Limitations: the on-chip trick only wins below ~6.3M parameters; larger models or long context spill to DDR and hit the bandwidth wall. The author compares this to Taalas, Cerebras, and Groq pursuing the same insight at enormous budgets. All engineering is bit-exact, measured on silicon, hand-written in Verilog (with Claude Code assistance), no HLS.
chinese_title: Show HN：一个在 250 美元的 FPGA 上以 21,000 tok/s 运行的微型 LLM（现场演示）

一位开发者将拥有316万参数的语言模型（INT4量化，约1.5 MB）完整塞入一块250美元AMD KV260 FPGA的片上SRAM中，在16个并行流上实现了59,965 token/秒的吞吐量，而真正单流对话约为21,300 token/秒。同一模型在该开发板的Arm核心上仅能以11 token/秒运行，在RTX 3050 Ti上则为719 token/秒。

核心洞见在于：单流token生成受内存带宽限制——每生成一个token都必须读取全部权重。由于开发板的DDR（约20 GB/s）由CPU与FPGA逻辑共享，把模型放在DDR中毫无收益；把所有权重保留在片上URAM/BRAM（约3 MB，带宽达数百GB/s至TB/s）才是全部关键。该模型使用TinyStories训练数据，并采用Kevin Malone式词形还原（“为何用许多词，少词即可”），将输出压缩约30%，带来约1.5倍的有效加速。

10万 token/秒的目标未能达成；作者证明了62k–78k token/秒是该芯片的硬上限，因为芯片缺少足够的DSP来在每个DSP48E2中塞入第三个MAC。16流纪录也被作者坦承为注水（注意力窗口仅一个token，文本毫无意义）；实际部署的实打实版本运行单流全上下文，约21,300 token/秒，在1到2,000个并发连接下保持稳定。

局限：这种片上方案仅在模型规模低于约630万参数时占优；更大的模型或长上下文会溢出到DDR，撞上带宽墙。作者将此与Taalas、Cerebras和Groq以巨额预算追求同一洞见的工作进行了类比。所有工程实现均位精确，在真实硅片上实测，手写Verilog（借助Claude Code辅助），未使用HLS。

title: Tail-Call Interpreters in Rust – Jimmy Ostler
summary:
The article explores tail-call interpreter techniques in Rust, inspired by a Scala VM dispatch post. The author implements a simple stack machine with five instructions (`Lit`, `Add`, `Sub`, `Mul`, `Div`) and benchmarks four dispatch styles:

- **Switch Dispatch**: A recursive `match` loop using the `become` keyword for guaranteed tail-call optimization.
- **Subroutine Dispatch**: Instructions as `&dyn Fn()` closures, using dynamic dispatch and global mutable state.
- **Indirect Dispatch**: Operations call a central `dispatch` function, which then calls the next operation.
- **Direct Dispatch**: Each operation directly calls the next instruction, eliminating the dispatch function; this performed best at 24.59 ns/iter vs. indirect (55.32), switch (59.39), and subroutine (79.93).

The author then extends the experiment to a 16-bit register machine with decode stages, comparing a simple switch-dispatch loop against a subroutine table of handler functions. They note the use of `static mut` and unstable features like `explicit_tail_calls` is purely experimental, not recommended production Rust. The article emphasizes that direct dispatch, which maximizes tail-call benefits, outperforms other methods, though numbers should be interpreted cautiously due to small benchmark sizes and compiler optimizations.
chinese_title: 尾调用解释器在Rust中 – Jimmy Ostler
chinese_summary:
这篇文章探讨了 Rust 中的尾调用解释器技术，灵感来自一篇关于 Scala 虚拟机分派的文章。作者实现了一个具有五条指令（`Lit`、`Add`、`Sub`、`Mul`、`Div`）的简单栈式虚拟机，并对四种分派风格进行了基准测试：

- **开关分派（Switch Dispatch）**：使用 `become` 关键字实现递归的 `match` 循环，以保证尾调用优化。
- **子例程分派（Subroutine Dispatch）**：指令作为 `&dyn Fn()` 闭包，使用动态分派和全局可变状态。
- **间接分派（Indirect Dispatch）**：操作调用一个中央 `dispatch` 函数，再由该函数调用下一个操作。
- **直接分派（Direct Dispatch）**：每个操作直接调用下一条指令，省去了分派函数；这种方式表现最佳，为 24.59 纳秒/迭代，而间接分派为 55.32，开关分派为 59.39，子例程分派为 79.93。

作者随后将实验扩展到一个带译码阶段的 16 位寄存器机器，比较了简单的开关分派循环与处理函数子例程表。他们指出，使用 `static mut` 和不稳定特性（如 `explicit_tail_calls`）纯粹是实验性的，不推荐用于生产环境的 Rust。文章强调，直接分派能最大化尾调用的优势，因此优于其他方法，不过由于基准测试规模较小且编译器优化存在影响，这些数字应谨慎解读。

title: I Benchmarked Local LLMs on the Laptop I Have
summary: The article benchmarks local LLMs on a 2021 M1 Pro with 16GB RAM, arguing that typical local-model write-ups use expensive hardware. Five models were tested via Ollama: qwen3.5:4b/9b, gemma4:e4b-it-qat, gemma4:12b-it-qat, and qwen2.5:7b. The suite comprised 21 data-engineer-style tasks (SQL, debugging, JSON extraction, code prediction, trivia, long-document lookup), graded by execution. Results: gemma4:12b passed 90% (123 min), gemma4:e4b 86% (18 min), qwen3.5:9b 81% (114 min), qwen3.5:4b 62% (125 min), qwen2.5:7b 52% (3 min). The older model was fast but weak; modern reasoning models are accurate but slow, often spending thousands of tokens thinking—sometimes exceeding the generation budget and never answering. For quick factual questions, non-reasoning gemma4:e4b answered in ~0.6s, but gave confident wrong answers (e.g., chmod 750 vs 754). Reasoning models took 17–38s. Long-document questions worked but initial prompt processing took 32–148 seconds, making agent-style workflows impractical on this laptop. Cost analysis: the entire 210-run benchmark costs $0.14 on DeepSeek or $0.10 on Muse, versus hours of local compute; local is not cheaper unless your time is worthless. Real reasons to run locally are privacy, offline use, or API outages. The author would keep only gemma4:e4b-it-qat as a free offline fallback and JSON extractor. Conclusion: local models on a normal laptop work better than expected, but won't reduce AI bills—the original motivation.

title: How We Pushed CDC into Postgres
summary:
The article describes Snowflake's Data Mirroring for Snowflake Postgres, a new feature that reimagines PostgreSQL change data capture (CDC) by replacing fragile pull-based replication with a push-based system.

Traditional logical decoding exposes a stream of changes to an external client, which then handles snapshots, schema changes, failures, and consistency. This approach is brittle and operationally heavy. Data Mirroring instead uses a Postgres extension called `snowflake_cdc` to continuously push batches of row-level changes into Iceberg tables (as Parquet) in object storage, along with a meta log tracking the replicated LSN. Because the extension runs inside Postgres, it can coordinate DML/DDL transactions, snapshots, and schema changes precisely.

The system operates on a single timeline across four stages: write → decode → capture → apply. The extension decodes WAL and finalizes batches, which are appended to change logs; Snowflake later applies adjacent batches transactionally, preserving transaction boundaries and foreign keys. This transactional approach avoids expensive upserts — inserts are simply appended — and enables "live views," which combine unapplied change logs with base tables for low-lag queries without frequent apply cycles.

The design decouples producer and consumer via object storage, removes external connectors, and eliminates common failure modes. Once set up, replication runs indefinitely with low cost, low lag, and transactional consistency. The article also mentions Postgres for your data lake (pg_lake) as a complementary SQL-driven tool for flexible data movement, while Data Mirroring is the always-on, automatic replication option.
chinese_title: 我们如何将CDC引入Postgres
chinese_summary:
本文介绍了 Snowflake 针对 Snowflake Postgres 推出的 Data Mirroring 功能，该功能重新构想了 PostgreSQL 变更数据捕获（CDC），用基于推送的系统取代了脆弱的基于拉取的复制。

传统的逻辑解码将变更流暴露给外部客户端，由客户端处理快照、模式变更、故障和一致性。这种方法既脆弱又运维繁重。Data Mirroring 则使用名为 `snowflake_cdc` 的 Postgres 扩展，持续将行级变更批量推送到对象存储中的 Iceberg 表（以 Parquet 格式），并附带跟踪已复制 LSN 的元日志。由于该扩展运行在 Postgres 内部，它可以精确协调 DML/DDL 事务、快照和模式变更。

该系统在单一时间线上运行，分为四个阶段：写入 → 解码 → 捕获 → 应用。扩展解码 WAL 并完成批次，批次追加到变更日志中；Snowflake 随后以事务方式应用相邻批次，保留事务边界和外键。这种事务性方法避免了昂贵的更新插入（upsert）——插入只需追加——并实现了“实时视图”（live views），该视图将未应用的变更日志与基础表结合，无需频繁的应用周期即可进行低延迟查询。

该设计通过对象存储将生产者和消费者解耦，去除了外部连接器，消除了常见故障模式。一旦设置完成，复制便可以无限期运行，成本低、延迟低，且具有事务一致性。文章还提到了 Postgres for your data lake (pg_lake) 作为补充的 SQL 驱动工具，用于灵活的数据移动，而 Data Mirroring 则是始终在线的自动复制选项。

title: The bureaucratic AI arms-race is mutually assured destruction
summary:
The article argues that using AI to combat AI-generated bureaucratic claims creates an arms race leading to "mutually assured destruction." It critiques an Economist editorial claiming AI will "break the British state" by making it too easy to file complaints and appeals. The Economist proposes cutting entitlements and using more AI to arbitrarily deny services—a "solutionist" fix that sacrifices the purpose of public services.

Political scientist Henry Farrell warns this will escalate into robotic battles between stingy AI bureaucrats and aggressive AI lawyers. Citing Alan Moore's 1980s character Abelard Snazz, who builds escalating Big Police Robots and Big Criminal Robots, Farrell notes ordinary people become collateral damage. This is already happening in U.S. healthcare, where insurers use AI to deny claims and doctors use AI to appeal them.

Parallels include the spam wars—where escalating anti-spam measures led to email domination by a few corporations—and content moderation, where trolls mastered platform rules to abuse victims. The article cites Stafford Beer: "the purpose of a system is what it does." If bureaucracy focuses on fighting fraud over delivering services, it becomes a service-denial system. The best response, as the title suggests, is not to engage in the arms race at all.

The article also includes a postscript recommending an FT piece by Farrell and Dan Wang on Philip K. Dick's relevance to current politics. The rest of the page contains standard blog links: "Hey look at this," "Object permanence" (historical links), upcoming appearances, and book notes.
chinese_title: 官僚式AI军备竞赛是相互确保摧毁
chinese_summary:
这篇文章认为，利用人工智能来对抗人工智能生成的官僚主义申请，会引发一场军备竞赛，最终导致“相互确保毁灭”。文章批评了《经济学人》的一篇社论，该社论声称人工智能将“瓦解英国国家机器”，因为它让提交投诉和上诉变得过于容易。《经济学人》提议削减福利，并利用更多人工智能来武断地拒绝服务——这是一种“解决方案主义”式的修补，牺牲了公共服务的宗旨。

政治学家亨利·法雷尔警告说，这将升级为吝啬的人工智能官僚与咄咄逼人的人工智能律师之间的机器人战争。法雷尔引用了艾伦·摩尔1980年代创作的角色阿贝拉多·斯纳兹——该角色制造了不断升级的“大警察机器人”和“大罪犯机器人”——并指出普通民众成了附带损害。这已经发生在美国的医疗保健领域：保险公司用人工智能拒绝理赔，医生则用人工智能提出上诉。

类似的例子还包括垃圾邮件之战——不断升级的反垃圾邮件措施最终导致电子邮件被少数企业垄断——以及内容审核领域，网络 troll 掌握了平台规则来虐待受害者。文章引用了斯塔福德·比尔的话：“系统的目的就是它的所作所为。”如果官僚机构专注于打击欺诈而非提供服务，它就变成了一个拒绝服务的系统。正如标题所暗示的，最好的回应是根本不参与这场军备竞赛。

文章末尾还附有一段后记，推荐了法雷尔和丹·王合作撰写的一篇关于菲利普·迪克与当下政治关联的英国《金融时报》文章。页面其余部分是常规的博客链接：“看看这个”、“对象恒久性”（历史链接）、即将出席的活动以及读书笔记。

title: Study links GLP-1 drugs to bigger jump in women's employment than a degree
summary:
Harvard research suggests GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are linked to significant employment gains for women. The working paper, by Harvard economist Rebecca Diamond, found that women who were unemployed when they started taking GLP-1 medications saw their employment rate rise by nearly 27 percentage points over 18 months, compared with similar women who wanted the drugs but had not yet taken them. That increase is larger than the employment gap between American women with a high school diploma and those with a college degree.

The study, which matched participants on income, race, BMI, and health, also found that single women taking GLP-1s were about 29 percentage points more likely to marry or move in with a partner. Notably, women already employed did not see higher pay or promotion odds. The author argues the gains likely reflect bias: losing weight did not make women more qualified, but may change how employers perceive them.

The article places these findings in the context of known weight-related workplace penalties. Earlier research cited by the St. Louis Fed found overweight white women earn about 4.5% less than normal-weight white women, and those with obesity earn nearly 12% less. A Fairygodboss study also showed hiring professionals judged heavier women more harshly, with 20% calling them “lazy” and only 18% seeing leadership potential.

The piece also discusses “pretty privilege,” citing Codie Sanchez’s claim that women who wear makeup earn about 30% more. It concludes the uncomfortable implication is that appearance, not ability, may shape economic opportunity for women.
chinese_title: 研究：GLP-1类药物带来的女性就业增幅超过学位。
chinese_summary:
哈佛大学的研究表明，GLP-1减肥药物与女性就业率的显著提升有关。这份由哈佛经济学家丽贝卡·戴蒙德撰写的工作论文发现，与那些想要服用但尚未服用这些药物的相似女性相比，开始服用GLP-1药物时处于失业状态的女性，其就业率在18个月内上升了近27个百分点。这一增幅甚至大于美国拥有高中学历女性与拥有大学学历女性之间的就业差距。

该研究在收入、种族、BMI和健康状况方面对参与者进行了匹配，还发现服用GLP-1药物的单身女性结婚或与伴侣同居的可能性高出约29个百分点。值得注意的是，已经就业的女性并未获得更高的薪酬或晋升机会。作者认为，这些收益很可能反映了偏见：减肥并没有让女性更有能力，但可能会改变雇主对她们的看法。

文章将这些发现置于已知的与体重相关的工作场所惩罚背景中。圣路易斯联储引用的早期研究发现，超重的白人女性比正常体重的白人女性收入低约4.5%，而肥胖女性的收入则低近12%。Fairygodboss的一项研究也显示，招聘专业人士对体重较重的女性评价更加苛刻，其中20%称她们“懒惰”，只有18%认为她们具有领导潜力。

文章还讨论了“美貌特权”，引用了科迪·桑切斯的说法，即化妆的女性收入高出约30%。其结论是，一个令人不安的暗示是：塑造女性经济机会的可能是外貌，而非能力。

title: ATProto for Distributed Systems Engineers
summary:
The article explains AT Protocol (ATProto) for distributed systems engineers by framing it as a decentralized version of a modern high-scale backend.

It begins with the evolution of a typical web backend: a single SQL database, then caches, sharding, and eventually a NoSQL cluster to improve scalability. To regain query features, developers build precomputed "view servers" and synchronize them via an event log (like Kafka), forming a stream-processing architecture. This sacrifices strong consistency but scales well.

ATProto applies this same architecture in a decentralized way. Instead of keeping internal services isolated, each component—data repositories, event logs, view servers—becomes a public service that anyone can host and consume. This creates an open network of cooperating servers.

The key innovation is a unified data model: each user has a "data repository" containing collections of JSON documents called "records." These records are assigned URLs and cryptographically signed for authenticity. This standardization lets different apps share and sync data across the network.

The typical app flow: a user logs in via OAuth, authorizing an app to read/write their repository. Writes are committed to the repo and broadcast through event logs to view servers. The app then reads from these view servers, which aggregate data from many repos. This circular flow lets multiple apps and users contribute to a shared, scalable network.

The article emphasizes that ATProto combines peer-to-peer techniques with high-scale backend practices, aiming to deliver the convenience of a global social app while remaining open. It notes the founders' experience with IPFS and Dat, and that Martin Kleppmann, author of *Designing Data-Intensive Applications*, is an advisor—highlighting the engineering-first approach behind the protocol.
chinese_title: 面向分布式系统工程师的ATProto
chinese_summary:
本文面向分布式系统工程师，将 AT 协议（ATProto）解释为一个去中心化的现代大规模后端系统。

文章首先介绍典型 Web 后端的演化过程：从单个 SQL 数据库开始，然后引入缓存、分片，最终使用 NoSQL 集群来提升可扩展性。为了重新获得查询能力，开发者构建了预计算的“视图服务器”，并通过事件日志（如 Kafka）进行同步，从而形成流处理架构。这种方式牺牲了强一致性，但扩展性很好。

ATProto 以去中心化的方式应用了同样的架构。它不再将内部服务隔离，而是让每个组件——数据仓库、事件日志、视图服务器——都成为任何人都可以托管和使用的公共服务。这就构成了一个由协作服务器组成的开放网络。

其关键创新在于统一的数据模型：每个用户都有一个“数据仓库”，其中包含名为“记录”的 JSON 文档集合。这些记录被分配 URL，并通过密码学签名保证真实性。这种标准化让不同应用能够跨网络共享和同步数据。

典型的应用流程如下：用户通过 OAuth 登录，授权应用读写其数据仓库。写入操作提交到仓库，并通过事件日志广播到视图服务器。应用随后从这些视图服务器读取数据，而视图服务器聚合了来自许多仓库的数据。这一循环流程让多个应用和用户能够共同构建一个可扩展的共享网络。

文章强调，ATProto 将点对点技术与大规模后端实践相结合，旨在提供全球社交应用的便利性，同时保持开放性。文中还提到，该协议创始团队拥有 IPFS 和 Dat 的开发经验，而《数据密集型应用系统设计》一书的作者 Martin Kleppmann 担任顾问——这凸显了该协议背后工程优先的思路。

title: Self-Hosted Inference for Agents
summary:
SIE (Superlinked Inference Engine) is an open-source, self-hosted inference engine designed to run all models behind AI agents through a single API. It replaces the need for separate model servers per task, serving 100+ models from one cluster in your cloud.

Key features include an OpenAI-compatible API (`/v1/embeddings`, `/v1/chat/completions`, etc.), a pre-configured model catalog (Stella, SPLADE, Qwen3, GLiNER, SigLIP, and more), simultaneous serving of multiple models with on-demand loading and LRU eviction, and a full production stack with load-balancing gateway, KEDA autoscaling, Grafana dashboards, and Terraform modules for GKE, EKS, and AKS. It integrates with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, DSPy, CrewAI, Chroma, Qdrant, Weaviate, and LanceDB.

SIE covers five main agent tasks: search (embedding, matching, reranking), document-to-markdown conversion (PDFs, Office files, scans), structured output (schema-valid JSON), content safety, and running the agent loop (planning and tool calling). Quickstart is simple: install via `pip install "sie-server[local]"` or run a Docker image (bundle-specific, e.g., CUDA, CPU, or Transformers 5 for OCR models). The server speaks the OpenAI API out of the box; first calls download model weights automatically. SDKs are available for Python and TypeScript, enabling embedding generation, reranking, entity extraction, and text generation in a few lines.

For production, SIE ships Helm charts with cloud-specific value overlays. It collects anonymous telemetry (version, OS, architecture, GPU type) but no IPs or request data; this can be disabled via environment variables. The project is Apache 2.0 licensed.
chinese_title: 面向智能体的自托管推理
chinese_summary:
SIE（Superlinked推理引擎）是一个开源、自托管的推理引擎，旨在通过单一API运行AI Agent背后的所有模型。它取代了为每个任务单独部署模型服务器的需求，可在你的云环境中的一个集群内服务100多个模型。

主要特性包括兼容OpenAI的API（`/v1/embeddings`、`/v1/chat/completions`等）、预配置的模型目录（Stella、SPLADE、Qwen3、GLiNER、SigLIP等）、多模型同时服务（支持按需加载和LRU淘汰），以及完整的生产级技术栈——涵盖负载均衡网关、KEDA自动扩缩容、Grafana仪表盘和适用于GKE、EKS、AKS的Terraform模块。它可与LangChain、LlamaIndex、Haystack、DSPy、CrewAI、Chroma、Qdrant、Weaviate和LanceDB集成。

SIE覆盖五大主要Agent任务：搜索（嵌入、匹配、重排序）、文档转Markdown（PDF、Office文件、扫描件）、结构化输出（符合Schema的JSON）、内容安全，以及运行Agent循环（规划与工具调用）。快速入门非常简单：通过`pip install "sie-server[local]"`安装，或运行Docker镜像（针对不同捆绑包，如CUDA、CPU，或用于OCR模型的Transformers 5）。服务器开箱即用地支持OpenAI API；首次调用会自动下载模型权重。提供Python和TypeScript SDK，只需几行代码即可实现嵌入生成、重排序、实体提取和文本生成。

在生产环境中，SIE提供Helm Charts，并附带针对特定云平台的values覆盖配置。它收集匿名遥测数据（版本、操作系统、架构、GPU类型），但不收集IP或请求数据；可通过环境变量禁用此功能。该项目采用Apache 2.0许可证。

title: Nvidia is pulling Wall Street into the AI buildout
summary:
A group of financial firms, including Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, BlackRock’s Global Infrastructure Partners, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR, is working with Nvidia on a $500bn funding package for AI infrastructure. Talks were reported by the Financial Times and confirmed by Bloomberg; a deal could come as soon as Monday.

The market reacted negatively, with Nvidia shares falling over 2%. The key caveat: almost nothing is settled. Bloomberg sources couldn’t specify projects, structure, or whether the $500bn represents new capital or repackaged existing commitments. This matters because Nvidia has already announced hundreds of billions in AI supply chain deals this year.

Nvidia has largely financed its own demand, including talks on a $250bn backstop for OpenAI, $350bn in financing for OpenAI chip purchases, and a $500bn+ partnership with SK Group. This pattern raises "circular financing" concerns—supplier funds buyer, buyer buys chips, revenue returns to supplier. The new package could address that criticism by spreading capital across independent balance sheets—but only if the underwriting is genuine.

Wall Street is already deeply involved: Apollo and Blackstone built a $35bn vehicle around Google TPUs, Morgan Stanley arranged a $917m loan backed by Nvidia GPUs, and the AI Infrastructure Partnership (with BlackRock, Microsoft, MGX, Nvidia, and xAI) targets up to $100bn. A $500bn package would be roughly five times that earlier program.

Big Tech is on track to spend $730bn on AI this year. The real question isn't the size but who bears the loss if data centers are built and demand doesn't follow—Nvidia, pension funds, or private credit investors.
chinese_title: 英伟达正带领华尔街投身人工智能建设

市场反应消极，英伟达股价下跌逾2%。关键警示是：几乎一切都尚未敲定。彭博社的消息来源无法说明具体项目、结构，或这5000亿美元是新资本还是对现有承诺的重新打包。这一点很重要，因为英伟达今年已宣布了数千亿美元的人工智能供应链交易。

英伟达在很大程度上为自己的需求提供了融资，包括与OpenAI谈判提供2500亿美元的担保，为OpenAI购买芯片提供3500亿美元融资，以及与SK集团达成的5000亿美元以上的合作。这种模式引发了“循环融资”的担忧——供应商为买家提供资金，买家购买芯片，收入又回流至供应商。新的方案可以通过将资本分散到独立的资产负债表上来回应这一批评——但前提是承销是真实的。

华尔街已经深度参与：阿波罗和黑石围绕谷歌TPU建立了一个350亿美元的融资工具，摩根士丹利安排了一笔由英伟达GPU支持的9.17亿美元贷款，而人工智能基础设施合作伙伴关系（参与者包括贝莱德、微软、MGX、英伟达和xAI）目标筹资高达1000亿美元。5000亿美元的方案规模大约是之前那个项目的五倍。

大型科技公司今年有望在人工智能上投入7300亿美元。真正的问题不在于规模，而在于如果数据中心建成而需求没有跟上，损失由谁来承担——是英伟达、养老基金，还是私人信贷投资者？

title: Felix and I
summary:
The article is a memoir about the author and his friend Felix in 2010, chasing a goal of becoming millionaires by age 30 through an “empire” of e-commerce affiliate websites. They used merchants’ product datafeeds to build clone sites that would rank higher on Google and earn 8% commissions on purchases. Each site took about a day to build, so they tracked progress on a Bristol board with 100 circles, slowly completing sites like decorcurtains.com and discountboatshoes.com. By December they hit 100 websites, earning $1,300 against $1,800 in expenses. In 2011 they paused growth, tweaking designs and taking freelance work, earning $5,300 total.

Interspersed with the business story is the author’s dating life. He briefly dates A, an infatuating but mismatched woman, then lies about being 27 and begins a slow-burning relationship with M, a fashion design student. He is tempted by another woman at a startup recruiting event but stays with M.

In 2012, he recruits an intern at a “Students For Startups” speed-dating event. He is strongly attracted to one ambitious student but deliberately chooses the second-strongest candidate, D, to avoid complications. D chooses him too. The administration later emails that D was not supposed to be in the room—he wasn’t enrolled in the co-op entrepreneurship course. The article cuts off there, leaving the outcome unresolved.
chinese_title: 费利克斯和我
chinese_summary:
这篇文章是一篇回忆录，讲述了作者和他的朋友菲利克斯在2010年追寻一个目标的故事——通过一个电子商务联盟网站“帝国”，在30岁前成为百万富翁。他们利用商家的产品数据源搭建克隆网站，让这些网站在谷歌上获得更高排名，并在用户购买时赚取8%的佣金。每个网站大约需要一天时间搭建，所以他们在一块布里斯托板上画了100个圆圈来追踪进度，陆续完成了decorcurtains.com和discountboatshoes.com等网站。到12月，他们达到了100个网站，收入1300美元，而支出为1800美元。2011年，他们暂停扩张，调整网站设计并接自由职业的活，总共赚了5300美元。

穿插在商业故事中的是作者的约会生活。他短暂地和A约会——一个让他着迷但并不合适的女人——然后谎称自己27岁，开始和时装设计系学生M展开一段缓慢升温的感情。他在一次创业招聘活动中被另一个女人吸引，但最终留在了M身边。

2012年，他在一场“学生创业”速配活动中招募了一名实习生。他被一个雄心勃勃的学生强烈吸引，但刻意选择了第二强的候选人D，以避免麻烦。D也选择了他。后来管理员发邮件说D本不该出现在那个房间里——他没有注册参加那个创业合作课程。文章到此戛然而止，留下了悬而未决的结局。

title: What Happened to HackerOne?
summary:
## Summary

The article critiques HackerOne’s decline from a hacker-focused platform to a sales-driven corporation. The author, a bug bounty hunter and program manager since 2017, draws on firsthand experience.

HackerOne originally filled a vital role by giving ethical hackers a legal, safe way to report vulnerabilities and get paid. Its “golden age” (roughly 2017–2020) featured exclusive Live Hacking Events (LHEs) that built a strong researcher community with custom posters, meetups, and direct engagement from hacker-led leadership.

Around 2020–2021, pressure to become profitable shifted the company. HackerOne had relied on ~$160M in VC funding. Leadership changed: the founding CEO was replaced by a corporate CEO, and HackerOne moved from a 20% bounty cut to capacity-based annual contracts, with sales and multi-year deals prioritized over product quality and hacker experience. Triage declined, low-quality programs proliferated, and the platform stagnated.

To manage top researchers, HackerOne created the exclusive Hacker Success Program (HSP), which gave elite hackers direct support but left newer hackers with little recourse, widening inequality. Platform feedback channels were performative, with no real changes.

In the AI era, HackerOne fumbled its opportunity, building “Hai,” an OpenAI wrapper, instead of fixing long-standing platform issues. The founders were sidelined.

The article describes “enshittification”: CEO Marten Mickos was replaced in late 2024 by Kara Sprague, a former F5 CPO with no hacking background. HackerOne rebranded around “CTEM” (Continuous Threat Exposure Management), becoming a soulless B2B sales operation.

Finally, in February 2026, ToS updates appeared to allow using hacker-submitted reports to train AI models. Researcher zseano flagged it; the controversy forced co-founder Alex Rice to do damage control, promising the policy would be clarified and that researcher data is not used for GenAI training.
chinese_title: HackerOne发生了什么？
chinese_summary:
## 摘要

这篇文章批判了HackerOne从一家以黑客为中心的平台堕落为销售驱动型公司的过程。作者自2017年起便是一名漏洞赏金猎人和项目主管，文章基于其第一手经验。

HackerOne最初扮演了至关重要的角色，为白帽黑客提供了一种合法、安全的方式来报告漏洞并获得报酬。其"黄金时代"（约2017-2020年）以独家现场黑客活动（LHEs）为特色，通过定制海报、线下聚会以及黑客出身管理层的直接参与，建立了一个强大的研究人员社区。

大约在2020-2021年间，盈利压力使公司发生转变。HackerOne此前依赖约1.6亿美元的风投资金。领导层更迭：创始CEO被职业经理人CEO取代，HackerOne从抽取20%赏金的模式转向基于规模的年度合同，销售和多年期合同被置于产品质量和黑客体验之上。漏洞审核水平下降，低质量项目泛滥，平台停滞不前。

为了管理顶尖研究人员，HackerOne设立了专属的"黑客成功计划"（HSP），为精英黑客提供直接支持，却让新晋黑客几乎没有求助途径，加剧了不平等。平台反馈渠道形同虚设，没有任何实质性改变。

进入AI时代，HackerOne错失良机，打造了一个OpenAI套壳产品"Hai"，而不是修复长期存在的平台问题。创始人们被边缘化。

文章描述了"平台堕落化"（enshittification）过程：CEO马腾·米科斯在2024年底被卡拉·斯普拉格取代——她曾任F5首席产品官，没有黑客背景。HackerOne围绕"CTEM"（持续威胁暴露管理）重塑品牌，沦为一家毫无灵魂的B2B销售机器。

最后，2026年2月，服务条款更新似乎允许使用黑客提交的报告来训练AI模型。研究员zseano指出这一问题，引发争议，迫使联合创始人亚历克斯·赖斯出面危机公关，承诺将澄清相关政策，并保证不会将研究员数据用于生成式AI训练。

title: I've vibe coded an application to see what it's like
summary:

title: Humanity renamed genes because of Excel
summary:
Excel’s automatic type conversion has corrupted biological data by turning gene names resembling dates into date values—e.g., `SEPT2` becomes `2-Sep` and `MARCH1` becomes `1-Mar`. This silent alteration was first noticed by bioinformaticians in 2004, and a 2016 survey of leading genomics journals found that about one-fifth of supplementary Excel gene lists contained such errors. As a result, many datasets remain corrupted and downstream analysis can ignore or misidentify genes.

To address the problem, the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee renamed dozens of human gene symbols so they would no longer be mistaken for dates, such as changing `SEPT1` to `SEPTIN1`. Researchers also built repair tools: “Escape Excel” (2017) prevents the conversion before import, and “Gene Updater” (2022) converts corrupted date-like entries back to correct gene symbols. The official recommendation remains to set cell formatting to text before importing data into Excel. The episode highlights how a ubiquitous consumer program can inadvertently shape scientific nomenclature and necessitate workarounds.

title: Tech leaders say AI means less work – staff say they work up to 90 hours a week
summary:
Despite tech leaders claiming AI will reduce working hours, employees inside AI-focused companies report working far more—often 70 to 90 hours a week.

Executives have long predicted shorter weeks: a Google director said AI would bring a four-day week by 2025, and OpenAI urged companies to trial four-day weeks. But a former OpenAI employee said the company never tested that idea internally, describing instead a grueling culture of weekend work, crisis meetings, and harsh performance reviews. Workers at OpenAI and Anthropic said “sprints” around product releases can stretch for weeks and top 90 hours in seven days.

At Meta, employees said they were “drafted” onto urgent AI teams without choice, leading to late-night and weekend work and constant on-call pressure. Meta has also laid off 10% of staff. Anthropic’s CEO warned AI could cause broader job losses.

Even workers not directly building AI feel the strain. A former Google engineer said AI projects drained resources, causing internal systems to fail and forcing him to work through the night; he left and said his health improved.

Research supports these accounts. A UC Berkeley study found tech workers using AI worked faster, took on more tasks, and extended their hours, partly because they had to constantly check AI output. MIT scholar Neil Thompson noted that any time savings are “sucked up” by implementing and monitoring the technology. “People assume 20% less work means four-day weeks,” he said, “but new work emerges.”

The article concludes that, contrary to promises of less work, AI appears to be increasing workloads and pressure for many tech employees.

title: ChatGPT Knows Who It'll Recommend Before It Searches
summary:
ChatGPT writes its own web-search queries before fetching anything, and those queries already contain brand names the user never mentioned. In a test, asking for "best AI note taking app" produced a first search naming Granola, Notion AI, Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, Mem and Limitless — all from the model's memory, not from search results. The pattern held across most categories: when ChatGPT must supply the products itself, it reaches into training data to build a shortlist. Asking the same question differently changes the list, so it isn't a fixed table.

The core finding: brands named in ChatGPT's own query are mentioned in the final answer 68.9% of the time, versus 2.1% for brands only retrieved but never named — roughly a 33x difference. A brand can be recommended without its website ever being crawled.

A second, harsher filter determines citations. Of 3,554 retrieved pages across 57 conversations, only 110 (3.1%) were cited. Position within a domain group matters sharply: 5.2% cite rate for first position, falling to 0.6% by fifth. Having many pages from one domain cannibalizes conversion — two tightly matched pages is the sweet spot; six-plus pages drops cite rate to 1.7%.

Practical advice splits into two games:
1. **Being in the category vocabulary** — built by being written about, reviewed and compared across the open web for years. Technical fixes like schema or llms.txt can't help since the decision happens before your server is contacted.
2. **Winning citations once named** — consolidate overlapping pages per intent, put the claim-bearing sentence in plain HTML near the top, include numbers, and avoid near-identical page clusters.

The author discloses owning Keyword Insights, a tool mentioned for finding intent-overlap pages. Trial: run your category question five times and note which brands appear in the queries.
chinese_title: ChatGPT在搜索之前就知道会推荐谁

核心发现：在ChatGPT自身查询中被提及的品牌，有68.9%的概率出现在最终答案中，而仅被检索但从未被提及的品牌只有2.1%——相差约33倍。一个品牌即使其网站从未被爬取，也可能获得推荐。

第二道更为严苛的筛选决定了引用的去向。在57次对话中检索到的3,554个页面里，仅有110个（3.1%）被引用。域名组内的位置影响显著：第一位引用率为5.2%，到第五位降至0.6%。同一域名下页面过多会蚕食转化率——两个高度匹配的页面是最佳选择；六个以上页面会使引用率降至1.7%。

实用建议分为两条路径：
1. **进入品类词汇**——通过在开放网络上被长期撰写、评测和对比来构建。schema或llms.txt等技术性修复无法奏效，因为决策发生在你的服务器被访问之前。
2. **被提及后赢得引用**——针对每个意图整合重叠页面，将承载主张的句子以纯HTML形式放在靠近顶部的位置，加入数字，避免近乎相同的页面集群。

title: Ocean heat records broken as hottest July temperature recorded
summary:
The world’s oceans recorded their highest-ever July sea surface temperature, averaging 20.96°C outside polar regions, according to the EU’s Copernicus Climate Change Service. This beat the previous record of 20.89°C set in 2023, partly driven by developing El Niño conditions in the Pacific, compounded by human-caused global warming.

Last month was the joint second-warmest July globally, at 1.47°C above pre-industrial levels. Record ocean heat is significant because seas absorb most excess greenhouse gas heat, and warmer water expands, driving sea-level rise. It also fuels longer marine heatwaves, mass coral bleaching, and more intense tropical storms with heavier rainfall.

Western Europe experienced its hottest June-July period on record, with an average of 21.62°C — 2.79°C above normal. Persistent high-pressure systems and dry soils trapped heat, with climate change intensifying the extremes. France, Spain, parts of Germany, and the UK saw exceptionally low rainfall and soil moisture, straining rivers such as the Seine, Rhine, and Danube. This worsened water shortages, agriculture, river transport, and energy production, and fuelled massive wildfires across the region, with smoke travelling long distances.

In the UK, England and Wales had their driest July since records began 190 years ago, with many areas officially in drought. The Met Office warns that once-extreme weather is becoming the “new normal,” noting the hottest day in southern England is now 4.5°C warmer than in 1961-1990. Scientists stress that El Niño may push temperatures higher still, against a backdrop of about 1.4°C of global warming since the late 19th century.
chinese_title: 海洋高温纪录被打破，七月气温创历史新高

西欧经历了有记录以来最热的6月至7月，平均气温为21.62°C，比正常水平高出2.79°C。持续的高压系统和干燥的土壤锁住了热量，气候变化加剧了极端情况。法国、西班牙、德国部分地区和英国的降雨量和土壤湿度异常低，使塞纳河、莱茵河和多瑙河等河流水量紧张。这加剧了水资源短缺，影响了农业、河流运输和能源生产，并在该地区引发大规模野火，烟雾远距离飘散。

title: Open QEC harness – greedy vs. GE, uniform vs. clustered k=4
summary:
The article presents the **Open QEC harness**, a finite-size diagnostic suite for quantum error correction (QEC), focused on circuit-level and holographic-style codes. It is digital/evaluation telemetry only, not hardware or a production decoder.

**Layers included:**
- **Layer A Surface:** Stim-based rotated surface code with MWPM smoke tests.
- **Layer A Floquet:** Period-3 honeycomb code, schedule-valid but not graphlike-MWPM comparable to surface.
- **Layer B Geometry:** Educational graph invariants, not circuit-level QEC.
- **Layer C HaPPY:** Tensor-network bulk-boundary encoding with greedy recovery and matched-sample GF(2) Gaussian elimination (GE) ablation. Depths: depth-1 (n=10, k=6) and capped depth-2 (n=20, k=16).

**Headline results (seed=42):**
- Matched greedy vs. GE with same erasure masks at p_erase=0.3:
  - Depth 1: greedy central 0.664, GE central 0.304.
  - Depth 2: greedy 0.59, GE 0.0575.
- GE is **not** a recovery superset of greedy; the gap widens at depth-2.
- Pattern stress (depth-1, k-matched):
  - Uniform k=4: greedy ~0.27, GE ~0.02.
  - Clustered k=4: greedy 1.0, GE 0.0.
  - k=4 remains special for greedy; GE is near floor in both modes. Result is decoder × pattern, not universal geometry.

**Data availability:** Frozen JSON under `public/data/` is preferred over re-running sweeps.

**BP micro-lab (Phase E0/E1):** Classical Hamming [7,4] min-sum belief propagation, not HaPPY. Metrics defined:
- `ge_unique_recoverability`: rank(H_E)=|E| over GF(2).
- `bp_codeword_match`: BP matches all-zero codeword with zero syndrome.
- `bp_osd0_syndrome_valid`: OSD-0 finds syndrome-valid completion.
- `bp_osd1_syndrome_valid` / `bp_osd1_codeword_match`: OSD-1 list completion metrics.

These metrics are not interchangeable: GE measures uniqueness, BP measures codeword match, OSD measures list completion.
chinese_title: 开源QEC测试平台 – 贪婪 vs. GE，均匀 vs. 聚类 k=4
chinese_summary:
本文介绍了 **Open QEC harness**，一个用于量子纠错（QEC）的有限尺寸诊断套件，专注于电路级和全息类码。它仅提供数字/评估遥测，而非硬件或生产级解码器。

**包含的层级：**
- **层级 A 表面码：** 基于 Stim 的旋转表面码，包含 MWPM 冒烟测试。
- **层级 A Floquet：** 周期为 3 的蜂窝码，调度有效，但无法与表面码在图状 MWPM 上直接比较。
- **层级 B 几何：** 教育性图不变量，并非电路级 QEC。
- **层级 C HaPPY：** 张量网络体-边界编码，采用贪心恢复和匹配样本 GF(2) 高斯消元（GE）消融。深度：深度-1（n=10, k=6）和受限深度-2（n=20, k=16）。

**主要结果（seed=42）：**
- 在 p_erase=0.3 下，相同擦除掩码的匹配贪心 vs. GE：
  - 深度 1：贪心中心 0.664，GE 中心 0.304。
  - 深度 2：贪心 0.59，GE 0.0575。
- GE **并非** 贪心的恢复超集；差距在深度-2 时扩大。
- 模式压力（深度-1，k 匹配）：
  - 均匀 k=4：贪心约 0.27，GE 约 0.02。
  - 聚集 k=4：贪心 1.0，GE 0.0。
  - k=4 对贪心而言仍然特殊；GE 在两种模式下均接近下限。结果是解码器 × 模式，而非通用几何。

**数据可用性：** 优先使用 `public/data/` 下的冻结 JSON，而非重新运行扫描。

**BP 微实验室（阶段 E0/E1）：** 经典汉明 [7,4] 最小和置信传播，而非 HaPPY。定义的指标：
- `ge_unique_recoverability`：在 GF(2) 上 rank(H_E)=|E|。
- `bp_codeword_match`：BP 匹配零综合征的全零码字。
- `bp_osd0_syndrome_valid`：OSD-0 找到综合征有效的补全。
- `bp_osd1_syndrome_valid` / `bp_osd1_codeword_match`：OSD-1 列表补全指标。

这些指标不可互换：GE 衡量唯一性，BP 衡量码字匹配，OSD 衡量列表补全。

title: A California Program Is Bringing Down the Cost of Heat Pumps by Buying Bulk
summary:
A California initiative is using group-buying to lower the cost of heat pumps, making the carbon-free heating and cooling technology more affordable. Vayu, a heat pump installation firm, partnered with marketplace VoltHub to launch the first California Heat Pump Group Buy, covering Los Angeles and the Bay Area. By lining up multiple households, installers can buy equipment in bulk, typically securing 15–30 percent discounts. Founder Shreyas Sudhakar, a former rocket engineer, notes that successful promotion often depends on weather; an early 2026 attempt flopped, but summer heat waves drove a surge in interest.

Similar programs exist elsewhere. Energy Gabriola on Gabriola Island, British Columbia, has operated since 2010, installing over 1,000 heat pumps and electrifying nearly half the island’s households. Its success was aided by the absence of rival installers.

Participant Naoya Kanai paid about $14,500 for a system in San Mateo, citing federal rebates and the group discount as key factors. While heat pumps can be efficient and comfortable, running costs vary. Andrew Sissons of Nesta highlights the “social contagion” effect of neighbors adopting the technology but stresses the need for quality installations. Harvard’s Roxana Shafiee notes that some households, especially in colder regions, may see higher bills than with gas heating. Efficiency ratings like the coefficient of performance are crucial, particularly in expensive electricity markets like California. Some buyers, like Ottawa’s Paul Holroyd, choose heat pumps mainly for environmental reasons, accepting modest savings as a bonus. The article concludes that group-buy schemes can help adoption but face limits based on home suitability and operating costs.
chinese_title: 加州计划通过批量采购降低热泵成本
chinese_summary:
一项加州倡议正利用团购方式降低热泵成本，使这种无碳供暖制冷技术更加负担得起。热泵安装公司Vayu与市场平台VoltHub合作，推出了首个加州热泵团购项目，覆盖洛杉矶和湾区。通过集中多个家庭的需求，安装商可以批量购买设备，通常能获得15%至30%的折扣。创始人谢雷亚斯·苏达卡尔曾是火箭工程师，他指出推广的成功往往取决于天气；2026年初的一次尝试以失败告终，但夏季热浪带来了兴趣激增。

类似项目在其他地方也有先例。加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省加布里奥拉岛上的“加布里奥拉能源”项目自2010年起运营，已安装超过1000台热泵，为岛上近半数家庭完成了电气化改造。其成功得益于当地没有竞争对手安装商。

参与者金井直哉在圣马特奥为一套系统支付了约14500美元，他表示联邦退税和团购折扣是关键因素。虽然热泵高效且舒适，但运行成本各有不同。Nesta机构的安德鲁·西森强调了邻里采用该技术的“社会传染”效应，但也指出安装质量的重要性。哈佛大学的罗克萨娜·沙菲伊指出，一些家庭，尤其是寒冷地区的家庭，可能会面临比燃气供暖更高的账单。性能系数等能效等级至关重要，尤其是在加州这样电价昂贵的市场。一些买家，如渥太华的保罗·霍尔罗伊德，选择热泵主要是出于环保原因，把小幅节省当作额外好处。文章总结道，团购计划有助于推动热泵的普及，但仍面临房屋适配性和运行成本等方面的限制。

title: Don't Build Mindreading
summary:
The article argues against developing mindreading technology, despite its potential benefits. It acknowledges the appeal: helping paralyzed patients, enabling verified honesty, aiding AI safety, and supporting suicide prevention. However, the core argument is that mindreading is an asymmetric tool that disproportionately empowers those who rule without consent—especially dictators.

Dictatorships rely on preventing information cascades and coordinated rebellion. Mindreading would let autocrats detect dissent the moment it arises, allowing preemptive "re-education" or killing. This is a more valuable capability to a dictator than to any democratic or productive use. Historical examples like Oskar Schindler's lies that saved lives, or IBM's technology used in Xinjiang, show how tools developed for good can be repurposed for oppression. Even with good intentions, technology leaks and advances for everyone; one company cannot control its use.

The author does not call for a boycott once it exists, but urges developers, funders, and researchers not to accelerate its creation. While acknowledging the alignment research benefits are real, they are outweighed by the immense risk of empowering tyrannical regimes. The article concludes: if a technology reads thoughts or feelings, it is a tool for tyrants, and we should delay its arrival.
chinese_title: 不要构建读心术
chinese_summary:
这篇文章反对开发读心技术，尽管其具有潜在益处。文章承认其吸引力：帮助瘫痪患者、实现经证实的诚实、助力AI安全、以及支持自杀预防。然而，核心论点是，读心术是一种不对称工具，会不成比例地增强那些未经同意而统治者的权力——尤其是独裁者。

独裁政权依赖于阻止信息级联和协调叛乱。读心术能让专制者在一出现异议时就察觉，从而允许先发制人的“再教育”或杀戮。对独裁者而言，这一能力比任何民主或生产性的用途都更有价值。历史上的例子，如奥斯卡·辛德勒的谎言拯救了生命，或IBM的技术被用于新疆，表明为善而开发的工具可能被重新用于压迫。即使出于善意，技术也会泄露并为所有人所推进；单一公司无法控制其用途。

作者并不呼吁在技术存在后对其进行抵制，而是敦促开发者、资助者和研究人员不要加速其创造。虽然承认对齐研究的益处是真实的，但它们被赋能暴虐政权的巨大风险所抵消。文章总结道：如果一项技术能读取思想或情感，它就是暴君的工具，我们应推迟其到来。

title: An alias-based formulation of the borrow checker (2018)
summary:
This article presents an alternative formulation of the Rust borrow checker, inspired by discussions at Rust All Hands. The key idea is to treat regions (lifetimes) not as ranges of program points, but as **sets of loans**—borrow expressions like `&x` or `&mut v`. A reference’s region collects all loans whose invalidations would make that reference unusable. Subtyping then becomes subset inclusion: `'a ⊆ 'b` means `&'a u32 <: &'b u32`.

The analysis is described in Datalog rules, implemented using the differential-dataflow crate. During type-checking, the compiler generates “base subset” relations between regions at specific control-flow points. These subset relations are propagated across the CFG, so once a region must outlive another, it remains true along all paths. The analysis also tracks “borrow_region” facts, linking a borrow expression to a loan, and extends these via flow to define a `requires` relation: a region `R` *requires* a loan `L` at a point if violating `L` would invalidate `R`. Liveness of regions is computed similarly to the NLL RFC.

The proposed system is intended to be behaviorally equivalent to NLL for end-users but with a different internal model that may enable future language features. A prototype passes the full NLL test suite and also handles cases that NLL cannot, such as issue #47680. Performance is currently slower than existing analysis, but the author is optimistic because optimization has not yet been attempted. The article emphasizes that regions as sets of loans offers a conceptual shift that may improve the compiler’s understanding of programs.
chinese_title: 基于别名的借用检查器表述（2018）
chinese_summary:
本文提出了一种 Rust 借用检查器的替代性表述，其灵感来源于 Rust All Hands 会议上的讨论。关键思想是不将区域（生命周期）视为程序点的范围，而是将其视为**借出（loans）的集合**——即像 `&x` 或 `&mut v` 这样的借用表达式。一个引用的区域收集所有会使该引用失效的借出。子类型关系于是变为子集包含：`'a ⊆ 'b` 意味着 `&'a u32 <: &'b u32`。

该分析用 Datalog 规则描述，并使用 differential-dataflow crate 实现。在类型检查期间，编译器会在特定的控制流点生成区域之间的“基础子集”关系。这些子集关系会沿控制流图（CFG）传播，因此一旦一个区域必须比另一个区域存活得更久，该关系在后续所有路径上都会保持成立。该分析还跟踪“borrow_region”事实，将借用表达式与借出关联起来，并通过流分析扩展这些事实，以定义 `requires` 关系：在某个点，如果违反借出 `L` 会使区域 `R` 失效，那么区域 `R` *需要*（requires）借出 `L`。区域的活跃性计算方式与 NLL RFC 类似。

所提出的系统旨在对最终用户而言在行为上与 NLL 等价，但采用不同的内部模型，这可能会为未来的语言特性提供支持。一个原型通过了完整的 NLL 测试套件，并且还能处理 NLL 无法处理的用例，例如 issue #47680。目前性能比现有分析慢，但作者持乐观态度，因为尚未尝试优化。文章强调，将区域视为借出的集合提供了一种概念上的转变，可能改善编译器对程序的理解。

title: Venaya – A financial wellness platform that adapts to your life stage
summary: Venaya is a financial wellness platform designed to adapt to a user’s current life stage. Its key principle, as highlighted in the article, is accessibility: users can start using the platform without granting bank access. Instead, they can track finances manually at first. Bank account connectors are optional and can be added later, meaning Venaya does not require a bank login to provide value. This approach lowers the barrier to entry and prioritizes user control and privacy.
chinese_title: Venaya——一个适应你人生阶段的财务健康平台
chinese_summary: Venaya是一个金融健康平台，旨在适应用户当前的人生阶段。正如文章中所强调的，其核心理念是可及性：用户无需授权银行访问权限即可开始使用该平台。相反，他们可以先手动追踪财务状况。银行账户连接器是可选项，可以稍后添加，这意味着Venaya不需要用户登录银行账户就能提供价值。这种方法降低了使用门槛，并将用户控制和隐私放在首位。
